first_vm_failure.cause: The appended native-loss fixture had not reenabled the test-only provider after the preceding ordinary lease tests. Production correctly declined handout.
first_vm_failure.correction: Enable component_provider only inside the mandatory native guest branch; the second VM run passes. Production implementation is unchanged between runs.

limitations: An instance-level fail-stop latch is implemented, not durable cross-process recovery.
Already-submitted file operations cannot be undone; client cached delegation and unrelated native host syscalls require additional coherence/recovery fencing.
